def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    cnt=Counter(x for row in grid for x in row)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]; W=set(cnt)-{bg}
    lab=[[-1]*w for _ in range(h)]; regs=[]
    for i in range(h):
        for j in range(w):
            if grid[i][j]==bg and lab[i][j]<0:
                r=len(regs); cells=[]; q=deque([(i,j)]); lab[i][j]=r
                while q:
                    a,b=q.popleft(); cells.append((a,b))
                    for da,db in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        x,y=a+da,b+db
                        if 0<=x<h and 0<=y<w and grid[x][y]==bg and lab[x][y]<0:
                            lab[x][y]=r; q.append((x,y))
                regs.append(cells)
    def run_extent(i,j,di,dj):
        n=0
        while 0<=i+di*n<h and 0<=j+dj*n<w and grid[i+di*n][j+dj*n] in W: n+=1
        return n
    fill=set()
    for r,cells in enumerate(regs):
        r0=min(c[0] for c in cells); r1=max(c[0] for c in cells)
        c0=min(c[1] for c in cells); c1=max(c[1] for c in cells)
        ok=True; border_bottom=False
        # required wall sides (or bottom border)
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            if grid[r0-1][j] if r0>0 else False: pass
        # top side
        if r0>0:
            if not all(grid[r0-1][j] in W for j in range(c0,c1+1)): ok=False
            elif run_extent(r0-1,c0,0,-1)>c1-c0+1 or run_extent(r0-1,c1,0,1)>c1-c0+1: ok=False  # ceiling tail
        else: ok=False  # top border side not allowed
        # bottom side
        if r1==h-1: border_bottom=True
        elif not all(grid[r1+1][j] in W for j in range(c0,c1+1)): ok=False
        # left/right sides
        if c0==0 or c1==w-1: ok=False  # vertical border sides not allowed
        else:
            if not all(grid[i][c0-1] in W for i in range(r0,r1+1)): ok=False
            if not all(grid[i][c1+1] in W for i in range(r0,r1+1)): ok=False
        if not ok: continue
        if border_bottom:
            # bottom side is border; ceiling must be a wall run with no tail (checked above)
            pass
        # region must exactly equal rect interior
        if set(cells)!={(i,j) for i in range(r0,r1+1) for j in range(c0,c1+1)}: continue
        fill|={*cells}
    return [[4 if (i,j) in fill else grid[i][j] for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
